title: Manufacturer Fleet Incentive Volume Schedule — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
Within the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, the manufacturer fleet incentive is tied to delivered fleet volume. This schedule gives each deal type's yearly volume threshold and the incentive credited per qualifying unit.

| Deal type | Fleet units the customer must take delivery of in the calendar year | Manufacturer fleet incentive per qualifying unit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 0 | 0.00 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 0 | 0.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 0 | 0.00 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 0 | 0.00 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 0 | 0.00 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 5 | 1150.00 |

A volume threshold of 0 means the deal type has no fleet incentive. Only the Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement carries one.

Hypothetical: a fleet customer whose third delivered fleet unit of the calendar year is the one under review has not reached the threshold of 5 units. Once its fifth unit of that year is delivered, the threshold is reached.
